chunks.arabic_text: رِجَالُ الْكَشِّيِّ: عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ بُنْدَارٍ وَ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ قُلَوَيْهِ الْقُمِّيَّيْنِ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي خَلَفٍ، عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ بُكَيْرٍ، عَنِ الزُّرَارِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ قَالَ

translations.en: Rijal al-Kashshi: From Muhammad ibn Masud from al-Husayn ibn al-Hasan ibn Bundar and Muhammad ibn Qulawayh (the two Qummi), from Sa'd ibn Abdallah ibn Abi Khalaf, from Ya'qub ibn Yazid, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Ibn Bukayr, from Zurara, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:

chunks.arabic_text: سَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ: لَعَنَ اللَّهُ بَيَانَ التَّبَّانِ، وَإِنَّ بَيَانًا لَعَنَهُ اللَّهُ كَانَ يَكْذِبُ عَلَى أَبِي أَشْهَدُ أَنَّ أَبِي عَلِيَّ بْنَ الْحُسَيْنِ كَانَ عَبْدًا صَالِحًا

translations.en: I heard him saying: May Allah curse Bayan the straw seller, and also [saying]: Bayan – may Allah curse him – used to lie about my father; I bear witness that my father Ali ibn al-Husayn was a righteous slave.

en.summary: This hadith from Al-Kashi's *Ikhtiyar* highlights the specific curse (la'n) upon Bayan al-Tabbân, a known fabricator who falsely claimed Ali ibn al-Husayn was merely a slave, thereby diminishing his Imamate. The narration, transmitted through a robust chain including Ibn Bukayr and Zurara, underscores the Shia emphasis on preserving the precise status of the Imams against early distortions. It serves as a foundational text for understanding the historical context of the curse on specific individuals who opposed the Ahl al-Bayt.
en.seo_question: Who was Bayan the straw seller and why was he cursed by the Imams?

key_terms.أَبِي: My father (referring to Ali ibn al-Husayn)
